description: This file defines the RelativeLayout class, a custom layout widget for the Kivy framework that positions child widgets relative to itself, with detailed handling of coordinate systems and touch events.

classes.name: RelativeLayout
classes.description: A custom layout widget that positions its children relative to its own position, extending FloatLayout with additional coordinate transformation and touch handling methods.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the RelativeLayout, binding layout triggers to position updates.

methods.name: do_layout
methods.description: Overrides the layout process to set the layout's position to (0, 0) before arranging children.

methods.name: to_parent
methods.description: Converts local coordinates to parent coordinates by adding the layout's position.

methods.name: to_local
methods.description: Converts parent coordinates to local coordinates by subtracting the layout's position.

methods.name: _apply_transform
methods.description: Applies translation to the transformation matrix based on the layout's position.

methods.name: on_motion
methods.description: Handles motion events, transforming touch positions to local coordinates before passing to super.

methods.name: on_touch_down
methods.description: Handles touch down events, transforming touch positions to local coordinates.

methods.name: on_touch_move
methods.description: Handles touch move events, transforming touch positions to local coordinates.

methods.name: on_touch_up
methods.description: Handles touch up events, transforming touch positions to local coordinates.
